excerpts: # Empowering Global Enterprises to Make Precise Pay Decisions with Ease

Trusaic’s innovative software solutions guide you toward precise, compliant pay decisions to help you achieve pay equity for your global workforce. Partner with Trusaic and turn every pay decision into progress.
To help enterprises achieve pay equity with the world’s most trusted software. We do this through constant innovation aimed at helping global organizations.
Identify, understand, and resolve pay inequities with elite guidance and support
Prevent pay inequity by ensuring fair and competitive pay at the time of hire
Streamline regulatory pay transparency reporting for confident compliance
Communicate with confidence, enhance trust with stakeholders

Read Bio Robert-Sheen | Trusaic ##### Robert S. Sheen CEO and Founder With an extensive background in law, finance, tax, and regulatory consulting, Robert Sheen is a serial entrepreneur and philanthropist.

Robert Sheen is the Founder and CEO of Trusaic. He leads the company’s mission to help global enterprises make precise, compliant pay decisions at scale — turning every pay decision into measurable progress.

Robert began his career as a tax attorney at KPMG and BDO before founding First Capitol Consulting, Inc. in 1999. He also founded and chartered US Metro Bank, an early adopter of remote check capture technology that has grown to more than $1.5 billion in assets.

What began as a regulatory technology company focused on tax savings, compliance, and business intelligence evolved into Trusaic. Under Robert’s leadership, Trusaic has pioneered a category-defining approach that combines data, regulatory expertise, and purpose-built software to solve complex workforce challenges. Today, Trusaic’s Pay Equity Software Suite helps organizations build unbiased, legally-defensible pay systems across global workforces.

Robert continues to shape the future of pay equity and transparency by helping organizations navigate complexity and strengthen accountability in their pay practices. His work is grounded in a clear belief: that fair pay is a fundamental right, and that with the right systems in place, every pay decision can move organizations closer to achieving it.

Trusaic also delivers industry-leading ACA compliance solutions, combining data integration, regulatory expertise, and fully managed services to help organizations reduce risk, streamline reporting, and stay audit-ready year-round.
Robert holds a Juris Doctor (JD) from Loyola Law School and a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration / Finance & Accounting from the University of Southern California.

Read Bio Fawn Rogers | Trusaic ##### Fawn Rogers Founding Partner and Advisor A successful entrepreneur and contemporary artist, Fawn Rogers offers strategic advisement to enhance organizational effectiveness and support the company’s goals and initiatives.

As a founding partner and advisor at Trusaic, Fawn Rogers provides strategic insights that support the company’s initiatives focused on pay equity, inclusive work environments, and the Affordable Care Act. She leverages her vision to further the company’s mission while overseeing monthly operations.

Born in Portland, Oregon, Fawn started traveling internationally in her teens and has explored over 80 countries. Based in Los Angeles for the past 18 years, she is a self-made entrepreneur, environmentalist, and global philanthropist focused on youth development, animal welfare, and environmental conservation. Fawn is also a contemporary multimedia artist whose work encompasses painting, photography, video, and sculptural installation. Her art addresses complex themes of harmony, existence, and ecological balance. Her work has been exhibited in galleries and institutions across five continents.
Read Bio Mark-Dwyer-BW-150-3 ###### Mark Dwyer Chief of Data Science

Mark is responsible for evolving Trusaic’s analytics regarding pay equity, diversity, and data consolidation processes as the company continues to scale and expand its robust data and analytic solutions. He brings over two decades of experience in statistical analysis to Trusaic, both as a faculty member at UCLA and within class-action litigation, where he provided oral and written testimony regarding statistical modeling.

Mark was formerly a Senior Economic Consultant for the Harris Economics Group, where he provided written and oral expert testimony regarding the interpretation of empirical analyses. He directed data cleaning and the construction of empirical models, among other responsibilities. Mark also worked as a Senior Economist for Econ One Research, Inc., and taught Econometrics as an Assistant Professor at UCLA.

He earned a Ph.D. in Economics from the University of Rochester, an M.A. in Finance from The Wharton School, and a B.A. in Physics from the University of Pennsylvania. He is a member of the American Economic Association and the Econometric Society.
Read Bio John-Leathers-BW-3 ###### John Ford Chief Product & Revenue Officer
John oversees global product development, operations, sales, and services across all of Trusaic’s product portfolio segments.

With extensive experience in product development, go-to-market, professional services and data analytics, John has led the development and deployment of multiple world-class SaaS HR tech solutions supporting mission-critical workforce priorities for global organizations. This includes Trusaic’s award-winning Workplace Equity technology platform and Trusaic’s comprehensive ACA Compliance & Reporting technology suite.
John holds a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration with a Minor in Music (Classical Violin) from Oregon State University.
Read Bio Gail-Greenfield-2-BW-3 ###### Gail Greenfield Executive Vice President of Pay Equity, Total Rewards and Solutions
**Executive Vice President of Pay Equity and Total Rewards Strategy and Solutions**

Gail Greenfield is an eminent pay equity expert who has recently joined Trusaic as Executive Vice President of Pay Equity and Total Rewards Strategy and Solutions. With over 20 years of experience, she specializes in developing data-driven strategies to promote workplace diversity, equity, and inclusion. Gail’s career includes roles at Oracle and Warner Brothers Discovery, and she has a rich history at Mercer, where she testified before Congress on diversity and inclusion. Her insights on pay equity have been featured in major media outlets, and she is a respected speaker at industry events.
Gail holds a PhD in economics from Claremont Graduate University and a bachelor’s degree in business economics from University of California, Santa Barbara.
Read Bio Anuj-Mongia-BW-150-2 ###### Anuj Mongia Executive Vice President of Products and Revenue
**Executive Vice President of Products and Revenue**

As the Executive Vice President of Products and Revenue at Trusaic, Anuj is one of Trusaic’s principal product strategists. He oversees ongoing expansion efforts into global markets both from a business development and product development perspective. His vast experience in operations, product development, and data analytics have enabled him to develop a comprehensive ACA compliance and pay equity software solution with the customer experience at its core.
Anuj has a Bachelor of Engineering degree in Computer Science, and a Master of Science in Financial Engineering from Claremont Graduate University.
Read Bio Ovais Malik ###### Ovais Malik Executive Vice President of Engineering

Ovais Malik serves as Executive Vice President of Engineering at Trusaic where he leads the company’s global technology strategy overseeing software development, cloud infrastructure and enterprise systems. With over 15 years of experience directing engineering organizations for market-leading enterprises ranging from $25 million to $3 billion in revenue, he has successfully scaled technology solutions across healthcare, financial services, logistics and commercial real estate. His expertise lies in modernizing complex portfolios from migrating legacy systems to cloud-native architectures. At Trusaic, Ovais drives agile transformation, operational excellence and secure, compliant engineering practices while fostering high-performing teams that align technical execution with business growth. A Computer Information Systems graduate, he champions leadership development and innovation to ensure technology delivers measurable impact.
Read Bio Christian-Liakos-2 ###### Christian Liakos Executive Vice President of Strategic Partnerships and Global Alliances
**Executive Vice President of Strategic Partnerships and Global Alliances**
Christian Liakos is Vice President of Strategic Alliances at Trusaic. He is responsible for expanding and nurturing Trusaic’s various partner strategies.
Prior to arriving at Trusaic he worked at various companies from early-stage startups to pre and post-IPO, as well as large global companies like IBM, ADP, UKG (formerly Kronos), and Avaya.

Christian has held various sales roles throughout his career. He began in telecommunications and supply chain industries before moving into the HR space where he’s been focused on building partner ecosystems from scratch to modifying and restructuring existing systems. Throughout Christian’s career, he’s been fortunate to have partnered with great organizations like UKG, Workday, ADP, Aon, Deloitte, Willis Towers Watson, and more.
